svg.title: 都市传说·都市怪谈 · 24 件素材
svg.text: Urban Legend — Ghost Stories · 24 SVG illustrations

svg.title: Flickering lantern / 摇曳的提灯
svg.desc: A patinated hurricane lantern with bowed guards, amber glass, a double flame, a riveted fuel tank and three pale moths. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Ghost silhouette / 幽灵剪影
svg.desc: A hooded apparition with cold eyes in a hollow face, reaching sleeves and layered bone-white cloth unfolding into a ragged hem. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Figure in the fog / 雾中人影
svg.desc: A hatted stranger in a long coat under a patinated street lamp; amber eyes hide under the brim and low banks of mist obscure the feet. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Weeping woman / 哭泣的女人
svg.desc: A long-haired woman covers her face at the water’s edge; weighted ivory folds, two cold tears, quiet ripples and a broken reflection suggest grief. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Shadow in the elevator / 电梯里的影子
svg.desc: An old elevator with a mechanical floor dial, worn metal doors and a narrow opening concealing a tall figure and pale fingers; amber light spills onto the threshold. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Abandoned hospital / 废弃医院
svg.desc: An abandoned hospital in three-quarter perspective, with broken windows, boarded doors, ivy and iron railings; one amber window holds a figure beneath a muted red moon. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Midnight subway / 午夜地铁
svg.desc: A last train emerges from a masonry tunnel on converging rails: a curved metal nose, twin lamps, blank destination board and a lone passenger behind reflective glass. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Empty classroom / 空教室
svg.desc: An empty classroom with an angled wooden desk, a displaced chair, a midnight clock and loose papers; chalk strokes and a handprint remain on the dark board. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Rooftop antenna / 天台天线
svg.desc: A rooftop aerial, guy wires and a drooping cable cross a raised water tank and an angled brick parapet beneath a cold moon; a long-haired figure stands at the edge. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Door at the end of the hall / 走廊尽头的门
svg.desc: A cutaway corridor uses one-point perspective, converging tiled flooring, wall panels and side doors to lead toward an ajar red door, a watching eye and a long floor shadow. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Open manhole / 敞开的井盖
svg.desc: A thick cast-iron manhole rim surrounds rungs disappearing into darkness, two pairs of eyes and pale gripping fingers; a slotted cover lies aside under two wisps of steam. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Cursed doll / 诅咒人偶
svg.desc: A porcelain doll in a faded crimson dress and bone lace, with articulated limbs, leather shoes, a button eye, a crack and a stitched smile; two fine pins pierce the cloth. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Cursed video tape / 诅咒录像带
svg.desc: An angled video cassette reveals molded sidewalls, twin reels and a worn paper label crossed out in red; a brown-black tape ribbon twists below. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Broken mirror / 破碎的镜子
svg.desc: An oval mirror with patinated metal, an aged brass rim and curled ornaments surrounds fractured cool glass; a muted red eye hides in an unfamiliar reflection above fallen shards. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Red string board / 红线线索板
svg.desc: Three instant photos and a clipping are linked by muted red thread: a stranger, a house with one amber window and a watching eye; pins hold the paper and a small brass bell hangs below. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Portable cassette player / 随身磁带机
svg.desc: A portable cassette player in three-quarter view has piano keys, visible twin reels, speaker slots and a volume wheel; a cable curls toward two earbuds beside a small drifting whisper. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Ringing payphone / 响铃的公用电话
svg.desc: An angled public payphone with an amber hood, a green display, twelve keys, coin slot and return; its receiver hangs from a coiled armored cable. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Unplugged ringing phone / 断线还在响的电话
svg.desc: A heavy rotary phone with a curved case, brass dial and Bakelite receiver catches narrow highlights; the cut cable exposes frayed wires while the phone keeps ringing. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Static television / 雪花电视
svg.desc: A wood-cased CRT on splayed legs, with rabbit-ear aerials, tuning knobs and speaker slots; curved green glass and analog scan interference partly conceal a long-haired figure. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Whispering radio / 低语的收音机
svg.desc: An arched wooden radio has carved grille openings, twin knobs, an amber tuning dial and narrow edge highlights; three pale, faced whispers drift above. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Black cat / 黑猫
svg.desc: A black cat sits in three-quarter view on a brick parapet, looking back with amber slit eyes; shoulders, haunches and paws are clearly formed, and the tail curls over the ledge under a cold moon. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Crows on the wire / 电线上的乌鸦
svg.desc: Three crows grip sagging wires while a fourth approaches on spread wings; a wooden pole, ceramic insulators and a strapped transformer form a complete piece of city infrastructure. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Blood moon / 血月
svg.desc: A muted crimson moon has irregular maria, rim-lit craters and a shaded limb; low clouds pass between bare branches while bats skim the edge. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.

svg.title: Cracked sidewalk / 裂开的人行道
svg.desc: Perspective paving slabs split along an irregular crevice with visible thickness and a dim crimson seam; a pale hand emerges among small weeds and chipped stone edges. Transparent background; material and shadow colors are fixed, with currentColor reserved for restrained contour accents.
